node.title: Re^2: A bizarre way to get a list of filenames
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
even the parser is sometimes confused

Nitpick: Unlike other cases, [id://1187521|such as map] or //, I think the rules for when <...> is [doc://readline] vs [doc://glob] are pretty clearly spelled out in [doc://perlop#I/O-Operators].

[kiz]: Note that using [doc://glob] has several caveats, described in [id://1206848]. In this particular example that you showed in your post, it's probably fine.
